test_health_servicer_check: test the async gRPC health servicer Check method for various service status responses
test_health_servicer_watch: test the async gRPC health servicer Watch method for streaming health status updates
test_health_servicer_service_isolation: test that health status changes in one service don't affect watchers of other services
test_health_servicer_graceful_shutdown: test the async gRPC health servicer graceful shutdown behavior and NOT_SERVING status transition
test_health_servicer_no_duplicate_status: test that the health servicer Watch method doesn't send duplicate status updates
